recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage leaves the projection blank, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0.
recipes.ownership: Own% is the average, by source weight, of the numbers Weekly findings file, Footballguys percent rostered and RotoWire projected roster % published for the DraftKings main slate; numbers for any other site or slate are never used. Stokastic DK cheat sheet is downloaded, stored and shown in its own column, but never averaged into Own% (weight 0). A number Adam types into the Own% cell replaces the published one for that player. A player with no published number is left blank: the app never estimates ownership, so game popularity exists only where a real number does.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

If Sanders takes over from Deshaun Watson (concussion) on a permanent basis, it could lead to plenty more big plays for Concepcion.

injury.comment: Mendoza will take over as the Raiders' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game versus the Seahawks after Las Vegas traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota on Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injury.longComment: The No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft has opened his professional career on the bench, with his lone action to date coming during garbage time of a blowout loss to the Patriots in Week 5, when he completed six of eight pass attempts for 48 yards. However, with the 4-5 Raiders shipping out Cousins for a 2027 third-round pick, the 23-year-old Mendoza will now be thrust into his first extended NFL playing time and will face a pair of tough defenses off the bat, as he'll follow up the matchup against the Seahawks with a road game in Denver in Week 11. Mendoza had underwhelming numbers over his three preseason appearances, but he's reportedly been "tearing it up in practice" during the regular season and has given the Raiders optimism that he's ready to lead the offense, per Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com.

The loss of Goodson leaves the Cowboys with no healthy running backs on the active roster beyond starter Javonte Williams, but team owner Jerry jones said that the team plans to sign a free-agent back Tuesday, per Archer. Dallas also has Israel Abanikanda and Jashaun Corbin as backfield options on the practice squad.

The 2024 sixth-round pick of the Patriots played nearly the full game in the 2024 regular-season finale against the Bills and got into four games with Dallas during the 2025 campaign, but this was Milton's first regular-season NFL start. Philadelphia's Week 10 bye will provide an opportunity to evaluate a QB room consisting of Milton, the recently benched Tanner McKee and rookie fifth-round pick Cole Payton. Whichever QB gets the starting nod in Week 11 against the Steelers would benefit from the potential return of Smith or Wicks after the bye.

injury.longComment: Lock continues to deal with a right elbow injury, and he's also tending to an oblique issue that he suffered this past Sunday against the Cardinals. He discussed the new health concern Thursday, telling Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle that he's "feeling good" and the oblique injury is on his backside, which is easier to deal with than if it was on the lead side. Lock so far has had his practice reps capped this week as a result, and Friday's injury report will determine if he enters the weekend with a designation for Sunday's game at Las Vegas.

injury.comment: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Beck will start Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Arizona first dealt Jacoby Brissett to Baltimore last Friday, and then Gardner Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his right elbow during this past Sunday's game at Seattle and will undergo season-ending surgery. That series of events precedes Beck taking over as the Cards' No. 1 signal-caller, and with eight other skill-position players on reserve lists at the moment, the top talents available to the offense will be TE Trey McBride and RB Tyler Allgeier.

injury.comment: The 49ers fielded trade inquiries for Jones from the Vikings leading up to Tuesday's deadline, but the quarterback is expected to remain in San Francisco, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.
injury.longComment: Even though starting quarterback Brock Purdy has been a leading MVP candidate through the halfway point of the season, the 49ers still place a premium value on Jones as an insurance option in the event Purdy misses time due to injury. As such, the 49ers' asking price for Jones was too rich for the Vikings, who have since pivoted their focus to acquiring Kirk Cousins from the Raiders.

injury.longComment: O'Connell is set to back up rookie Mendoza, who replaced recently traded Kirk Cousins as the starting quarterback. O'Connell has been with Las Vegas since the team drafted him in the fourth round of the 2023 NFL Draft. The 28-year-old last appeared in a regular-season game in 2025, completing 10 of 22 attempts for 102 yards.

injury.comment: Uiagalelei completed two of seven passes for 27 yards and a touchdown after replacing Justin Herbert (finger) in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans, and head coach Jim Harbaugh said after the game that Herbert could have a fractured finger, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
injury.longComment: Uiagalelei was inaccurate in his first taste of regular-season NFL action but threw a 15-yard touchdown pass to Derius Davis. If Herbert isn't available to face the Ravens on MNF in Week 10 and Trey Lance (groin) isn't ready to return from injured reserve, Uiagalelei would presumably be tabbed for the first regular-season start of the latter's career.

injury.comment: Sanders will return to a backup role for Sunday's game against the Texans after the Browns announced Wednesday that Deshaun Watson (concussion) will draw the Week 10 start, Kelsey Russo of the team's official site reports.
injury.longComment: Watson led the Browns to a 5-3 record over their first eight games before developing concussion symptoms and being placed in the NFL's five-step protocol last week. Though Watson cleared protocol last Saturday, his lack of on-field reps during the week prompted the Browns to keep him inactive for Sunday's matchup with the Saints. Sanders stepped in under center and overcame a slow start to finish with 297 passing yards, 28 rushing yards, two passing touchdowns and no turnovers in a 23-22 overtime loss, with his performance drawing praise from head coach Todd Monken. injury.longComment: After missing five consecutive games while recovering from an ankle sprain, Ferguson appeared poised to return from IR ahead of this past Sunday's game against the Commanders, but his activation was delayed after he pulled his hamstring while running a route during Friday's practice. Ferguson's 21-day window will come to a close Nov. 25, so even if he doesn't resume practicing before then, he'll likely need to show the Rams that he's made at least some progress in his recovery from the hamstring injury to get activated. McVay said that he would be open to adding Ferguson back to the 53-man roster before he's ready to play, but the Rams may not be keen on essentially playing a man down for more than a game or two.

injury.comment: Evans caught both of his two targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 26-21 loss versus the Broncos.
injury.longComment: For the third game in a row, Evans drew exactly two targets and caught both of them Sunday. With that said, he also again trailed in snaps at tight end (31) behind teammates Tommy Tremble (46) and Darren Waller (35), both of whom also drew more targets in Week 9. Evans' role in the Panthers' passing offense isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats going into a Week 10 matchup at New Orleans.

injury.comment: Sanders recorded zero targets during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
injury.longComment: Sanders was active for the first time this season. However, he didn't log any offensive snaps and spent all his time on special teams. The 23-year-old has appeared in 30 regular-season games during his career, amassing 62 catches (77 targets) for 532 yards and two touchdowns. Sanders has had a few quality performances throughout his short NFL career, though he likely won't have an opportunity to get involved offensively moving ahead while Tommy Tremble and Darren Waller are in the mix.

injury.comment: Trautman caught two of three passes for 15 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Trautman failed to record a catch across six games between Weeks 2 and 7, but he has logged two receptions in each of his two outings. His 41 offensive snaps ended up being ahead of fellow tight end Evan Engram (38), although the latter has been more involved in the Broncos' offensive game plan than Trautman. The Broncos' next game takes place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22.
